# nfc-reader (device class)

> PN53x-based NFC readers — the contactless equivalent of the badgelife class

A device class rather than a single device: the USB contactless readers built on NXP's PN531, PN532 and PN533 controllers, sold under many names — the ACR122U and Touchatag being the ones most people meet first.

## Devices in this class

*None catalogued yet.*

## Shared setup

Install the class packages, join `plugdev`, then log out and back in — group membership does not apply to an existing session. USB readers are usually found without configuration; a serial reader needs an entry in /etc/nfc/libnfc.conf. `nfc-list` should report the reader and its firmware.

## Shared tooling

[`libfreefare-bin`](../packages/libfreefare-bin.md), [`libnfc-bin`](../packages/libnfc-bin.md), [`pcsc-tools`](../packages/pcsc-tools.md)
